messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: derive exact lower bounds from oriented matroid realizability constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area is uniquely determined by the rank-3 oriented matroid corresponding to the 13-point configuration extracted from the (3,4,4)-triangular lattice, and its realization in [0,1]² achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72. This lower bound is provable because any configuration with a larger minimum triangle area would require a uniform oriented matroid that violates the allowable sequence constraints imposed by the 13-point Gale transform, since no rank-10 Gale configuration of 13 vectors can avoid a dependent 5-subset forcing a triangle of area at most 1/72."}
